line: Crowley on Atu X: the planet Jupiter, the letter Kaph, a continual change of state, and the element of luck (pdf p81).

sections.title: Planet and letter
sections.line: Crowley on Jupiter, the Greater Fortune, and on the letter Kaph (pdf p81).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the planet Jupiter, “the Greater Fortune” in astrology.
It corresponds to the letter Kaph1, which means 1Kaph 20 Pé 80=100, Qoph, Pisces. The initials K Ph are those of ?τεις and Φαλλος the palm of the hand

sections.title: Change of state and luck
sections.line: Crowley on the card as the Universe in its aspect as a continual change of state, and on Jupiter as the element of luck (pdf p81).

quotes.quote: This card thus represents the Universe in its aspect as a continual change of state.
It would be narrow to think of Jupiter as good fortune; he represents the element of luck.
